name_reason: Follows the data_fd2_battle_* convention for battle core state. Descriptor 'view_window_origin_x' correctly names its role (tile column of the battle viewport's left edge) and the scalar coordinate nature. No Ghidra address residue; trailing 'x' is a meaningful axis indicator, not an address. globals.h declaration already matches (extern uint32 ... /* 0x53AA9 */).
purpose: Battle viewport window origin X: the tile column of the on-screen viewport's left edge; runtime camera horizontal-scroll position.
logic_summary: Runtime camera-scroll state for the battle field view. Zero at load (BSS in .object2). Written/cleared by battle/chapter init and save-load (fd2_init_battle_state_for_chapter zeroes the 0x53AA9..0x53ABD cursor/window block; fd2_load_save_and_init_engine, fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro, chapter_10/20/30_end also write it), then INC/DEC by the horizontal cursor-move handlers (fd2_cursor_move_left/right), walk-step handlers, and pan functions (fd2_pan_cursor_and_window) as the viewport scrolls left/right. fd2_cursor_move_right caps scroll at map_width_tiles - 0xD (the 13-tile-wide viewport's max origin); fd2_cursor_move_left stops scrolling at 0. Compared only for equality (CMP/JZ) and stepped by 1, never used in a signed-ordering branch.
element_semantics: Scalar: tile column index of the viewport's left edge. Small non-negative value in range 0 .. (map_width_tiles - 13). Accessed as DWORD throughout (INC/CMP dword ptr [0x53AA9]).
notes: src comment block at cursor.c lines 264-273 is already accurate, concise, and conclusion-form (matches disassembly: DWORD INC/CMP at 0x11c23/0x11c31, BSS zero, init/save-load writers, range 0..map_width_tiles-13) -> kept unchanged. Ghidra data plate at 0x53AA9 was empty (null) -> created a concise plate via run_script_inline (PLATE_COMMENT, cu.setComment returns void in this Ghidra build). Verified non-const by WRITE xrefs (fd2_load_save_and_init_engine @0x103e8, fd2_init_battle_state_for_chapter @0x20619, fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro @0x23469, chapter_10/20/30_end). Unsigned is correct for this global (equality-only comparison), unlike cursor_screen_x/y which need signed; comment already distinguishes this. No logic changes made. No edit to cursor.c.
